plugins.name: team-board
plugins.description: A Team pane for agent teams: who is working, done, or blocked, with teammate messages folded to one line.

plugins.name: open-last
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the last file Claude wrote and any local dev server it started: open them in cmux, or stop the servers.

plugins.name: account-guard
plugins.description: A line above the prompt with the GitHub account a push would use, and a red warning when that account cannot push to the repo.

plugins.name: copy-draft
plugins.description: Under Claude's answers (terminal): a copy button for each code block, and a reply button for each table that fills the prompt box with one line per row. Also /copy-block [n] and /reply-table [n].

plugins.name: recent-chats
plugins.description: When Claude opens fresh, a band above the prompt offers this folder's last 5 chats, each with a one-line summary: press 1 to 5 to resume one, or type to start a new chat.
